title: Thai Chicken Bake
description: A moist and flavorful chicken dish, inspired by Thai cuisine, with a warm, velvety sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
In a separate pan, heat the coconut milk over medium heat.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and Thai red curry paste to the pan.
Stir until the mixture is smooth and fragrant.
Add the portuguese port wine to the pan and stir to combine.
Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish and pour the coconut milk mixture over them.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, slice the bake potatoes into wedges.
Toss the potato wedges with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
Add the potato wedges to the oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until crispy.
Garnish with green onions and fresh cilantro before serving.
